description: Chiggi Patches v1.15.1 — JioHotstar account-flag fix: adds 'Spoof device attestation'. The re-signed build was sending IsTampered=true in the device-attestation blob (Kg/b) it posts to the server, which flagged the account as suspicious activity and locked it 24h (error NM-4290). This patch forces all 8 attestation security flags (IsEmulator/IsRooted/IsTampered/IsProxy/isVpnActive/isSuspiciousFileExists/isPortsOpen/isDebuggerEnabled) to false at the blob constructor, so the app reports a clean device. WARNING: this only removes a client-sent signal — the server still sees the VPN exit IP and an already-flagged account stays on Hotstar's radar; do not run on an account you cannot afford to lose (test on a throwaway number first). Apps: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0), CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7), JioHotstar (in.startv.hotstar 26.06.22.3), Vi Movies and TV (com.vimtv 10.8), JioTV+ (com.jio.media.jiotvplus 2.6.4_2076).
